method: Published robots.txt and terms pages were read; single GET/HEAD requests were made to public endpoints and to the two public articles whose values are cited; web-search summaries were used for background only. Nothing was scraped in bulk and no paywalled content was opened. VERIFIED means read directly during the audit; REPORTED means taken from search summaries and not confirmed at the source.

policy.store: individual factual rank / grade / ETA values with a citation, and short DISI paraphrases (<= 500 characters)
policy.mlbam_terms: Only individual, non-commercial, non-bulk use of MLB.com materials is permitted (gdx.mlb.com/components/copyright.txt).

sources.access: free web pages; HTTP 406 to automated requests
sources.structured: pages are client-rendered; no public structured prospect-rank API (the draft endpoint below is draft-only)
sources.historical_depth: REPORTED: Top 50s from 2004, Top 100s with midseason updates from 2012
sources.has_fv_or_tool_grades: REPORTED: 20-80 tool grades and an overall grade
sources.stable_urls: article URLs with ids are stable; prospect-list pages are year-keyed
sources.ingest: manual single-value citation only; DISI's two signing trackers (2013, 2014) were already registered sources
sources.status: VERIFIED robots/terms; pages not read this audit

sources.structured: yes: pick, rank (recent years only), school, a scouting-report video link and a ~1,200 character editorial blurb
sources.historical_depth: queried for 2008, 2012, 2016, 2019, 2022; rank present for recent drafts only
sources.ingest: not used: covers drafted players only (DISI's cohort is mostly international), and the blurb is copyrighted text that must not be stored

sources.access: free articles; The Board full data / export reportedly needs a membership (not confirmed)
sources.structured: list tables with Rk, Name, Age, Highest Level, Position, ETA, FV, plus per-player tool-grade grids (present/future)
sources.historical_depth: REPORTED: FV era lists from about 2011
sources.stable_urls: NO: list pages use rolling URLs and are edited after publication (the Dodgers page was published 2025-12-05 and last modified 2026-02-09); an archive snapshot is needed for permanence
sources.ingest: single-page, individual factual values with citation; terms of use page not located (old URL 404), robots.txt permissive
sources.status: VERIFIED robots; page downloaded once and parsed

sources.access: mostly subscription; some free articles; print handbook
sources.has_fv_or_tool_grades: reports with grades are subscription content
sources.stable_urls: article URLs stable; paid pages are not accessible
sources.ingest: only individual ranks reported by free secondary articles; terms treated as all-rights-reserved
sources.status: VERIFIED robots; one secondary article (Sports Illustrated) downloaded and read

sources.ingest: none; robots crawl-delay 2, terms page not located

sources.structured: peak prospect ranks on minor-league pages (REPORTED), derived from third-party lists
sources.ingest: cross-check only: robots crawl-delay 3 and the data-use page prohibits automated access that affects site performance

sources.access: free; the availability API returned HTTP 429 after a short burst
sources.ingest: the intended home of archive_url; pace requests

known_gaps: Nothing structured and public before about 2004; players signed in the 1990s (for example Roger Cedeno) are expected to have no verified evaluation.
11 legacy MLB Pipeline international ranks (Dodgers 2015-2026) have no located public source and are queued, not stored as evaluation facts.
mlb.com and milb.com pages could not be read by automated tools (HTTP 406); this was not circumvented.

Historical FanGraphs / Baseball America / MLB Pipeline Top 100 lists for the proof-cohort players (Alvarez, Cruz, Diaz, Cartaya, Sasaki's MLB Pipeline rank) were not readable during this audit and remain candidates for later curation.
